name: ada
description: Ada: your models in rrotor, a sandboxed runtime on this machine. A spec and a small model file, deployed by commit, learning from the precedents they record; Claude deploys, calls and continues them.

runtime.title: Container runtime
runtime.description: Where rrotor runs. auto picks Apple's container (macOS 26, Apple silicon), then OrbStack, then Docker.

image.title: rrotor image (developers)
image.description: Leave empty for the rrotor image this version of the mod pins by digest. A local tag here (for a build of rrotor) is used as it is, unverified.

part.title: Ada part (developers)
part.description: Leave empty for the Ada part this version of the mod carries, signed by Glyphh. A folder here holding a local build (ada-<version>-<arch>.tar.gz with its .sha256 and .sig, from rrotor/parts/ada) is installed instead.
